calls.statement:
WITH cal AS (SELECT period_start_date s, period_end_date e FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=3),
l AS (
 SELECT f.*, p.sku, p.category, p.subcategory FROM fact_sales_line f
 JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE s.store_id=108 AND p.subcategory='Interior Paint'
   AND f.sale_date BETWEEN (SELECT s FROM cal) AND (SELECT e FROM cal))
SELECT (SELECT s FROM cal) s, (SELECT e FROM cal) e, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) ids, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) rl, sum(quantity) qty, sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN quantity END) staff_qty, sum(CASE WHEN quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos, min(etl_loaded_at) mn, max(etl_loaded_at) mx, count(DISTINCT category) cats, count(DISTINCT sku) skus
FROM l

WITH l AS (
 SELECT f.*, p.sku, p.subcategory AS sub_wasis, cp.subcategory AS sub_current, p.category cat FROM fact_sales_line f
 JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
 WHERE s.store_id=108 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'),
ctl AS (SELECT sum(units_sold) u, sum(net_sales_before_returns) n FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=108 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02')
SELECT sum(quantity) all_units, sum(net_amount) all_net, (SELECT u FROM ctl) ctl_units, (SELECT n FROM ctl) ctl_net,
 sum(CASE WHEN sub_current='Interior Paint' THEN quantity END) asis_units,
 sum(CASE WHEN sub_wasis='Interior Paint' THEN quantity END) aswas_units,
 sum(CASE WHEN sub_current='Interior Paint' AND cat<>'ZZ Test' THEN quantity END) asis_nontest,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cat='ZZ Test' THEN sku END) testskus,
 count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) ids, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id,line_no)) rl,
 min(sale_date) mn, max(sale_date) mx
FROM l

SELECT 'by_return_date' k, sum(r.quantity_returned) u, count(*) n
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id=108 AND cp.subcategory='Interior Paint' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'of_sold_lines', sum(r.quantity_returned), count(*)
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id=108 AND cp.subcategory='Interior Paint' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
